subject: Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed()  when building spatio-temporal model

messages.author: 9e5289c7687e8e58
messages.subject: Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed()  when building spatio-temporal model
parts:
Hi,

When I am running model with spatial correlation and ar1, it always crashes, i cannot find out the reason. Here is my code and attached is the error text. Would you please help me find the reason, thanks a lot.

bnd[["loc"]] = data_sp_t@coords
coo <- data[ ,9:10]

mesh=inla.mesh.2d(loc = coo,
                  boundary = bnd,
                  max.edge = c(1, 2),
                  cutoff = 0.01)
plot(mesh)
points(coo,col = "red", pch = 1)
mesh$n

data_tmp = data[data$date=="2015-10", ]

dist_mtx = dist(data_tmp[, c("easting", "northing")], method="euclidean", diag = FALSE)
dist_mtx = dist_mtx[dist_mtx != 0]
length(dist_mtx[dist_mtx <= 0.01]) / length(dist_mtx)


## SPDE
spde <- inla.spde2.matern(
  mesh = mesh, alpha = 2, constr = TRUE,
  #prior.range = c(10000, 0.01), # P(range < 10000) = 0.01
  #prior.sigma = c(3, 0.01) # P(sigma > 3) = 0.01
)

## index of spatial field
timesn <- length(unique(data$date))
indexs <- inla.spde.make.index("s",
                               n.spde = spde$n.spde,
                               n.group = timesn
)


group <-  rep(c(1:11), each=nrow(data)/11)
coo = cbind(data$easting, data$northing)
A <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh = mesh, loc = coo, group = group)
X = data[, c(3, 8, 11:14, 16)]

stk.e <- inla.stack(
  tag = "est",
  data = list(y = data$Yreli, offset=data$Ereli),
  A = list(1, A),
  effects = list(X=X, s = indexs)
)

f_2 <- y ~ perc_white + price_med + pm10 + board +
  dispensing + urban + december + f(s,model = spde,
                         group=s.group,
                         control.group = list(model = 'ar1')
                         )



poi_st_reli <- inla(f_2,
                    family = "poisson", E = offset,
                    data = inla.stack.data(stk.e),
                    control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic=TRUE),
                    control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE,
                                             A = inla.stack.A(stk.e)),
                    verbose=TRUE
                    )
